question: Can the YouTube Data API v3 set a Short's Studio 'related video', or pin a comment? Which scopes do videos.update and commentThreads.insert need?
source: https://www.googleapis.com/discovery/v1/apis/youtube/v3/rest (the machine-readable definition the reference pages at developers.google.com/youtube/v3/docs are generated from; developers.google.com itself is refused by this session's proxy)

findings.related_video_field: NONE: no property named related/linked video anywhere in the document (searched 'relatedVideo', 'linkedVideo', 'related': only relatedEntities of abuse reports, relatedPlaylists of channels, showRelatedChannels)
findings.comment_pin: NONE: comments methods delete, insert, list, markAsSpam, setModerationStatus, update; commentThreads methods insert, list; no pinned property in CommentSnippet or CommentThreadSnippet
findings.our_credential: HERO_YT_AUTHORIZED_USER_JSON has already posted commentThreads.insert comments (publish/ledger.json first_comment ids, e.g. pilot-012, genesis-01..03), which only youtube.force-ssl allows, and that scope also allows videos.update. arc_links.py checks the granted scopes again at every run before writing.

consequence: arc_links.py links Shorts and long by description and comment; the Studio 'related video' of each Short and pinning its comment stay the one manual step (OPERATIONS.md).
